notes.title: Latest Battle Royale Update (Our Next Game)
notes.content:
Hello fellow Aeons!

In case you're not staying up to date from our twitter, where we mostly post our updates, we've been retraining ourselves to code in Unreal Engine 4.26.

Our next game is going to be a slower paced battle royale that relies on tactical movement and positioning while also playing aggressively and scoring "kills" to level up your skill tree. We want to make a different kind of BR that punishes you for bad decision making instead of twitch reflexes or unlucky rng.

We still estimate a playable prototype within 3-6 months from now but depending on how difficult it is to setup the custom server logic, it could be sooner or later. Hopefully sooner.

In the mean time, we at Dragonflare Studios hopes you are all doing very well.

P.S. I also forgot to write that it will be free to play. We want to maximize the player base so it doesn't feel like a ghost town.

notes.title: Patch 11.19.2020.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Made the beginner tower cheaper and better damage along with perk point gain buffs.

1. Mg tower line (not plasma) reduced in cash credit price signficantly.

2. The first perk in the mg/plasma damage perk line grant a much bigger boost in damage (mg dmg 1, mg mk2 dmg 1, plasma dmg 1, etc).

3. Perk gain rate is now improved. Starts at 15 at wave 1 completed and goes up to 80 perk points gained per wave clear at max. This is up from 1 to 30.

notes.title: Patch 11.18.2020.1
notes.content:
1. Changed crypto mining perks and unit cash perks to reward significantly more cash per wave clear.

2. Changed the stun effect on missile towers in an attempt to bypass an enemy invincibility bug. Most enemies are stun immune anyway.

3. Added new ability: Trade 50 neutronium for $300,000 US credits
